“Ninja Massage Therapy.”  It’s based on the concept of using your whole body for your main source of power & using continuous sporadic joint movements to check clients’ relaxation state at all times, all while Myofascial & muscle unraveling during stretches.

I maintain continuous contact with clients while having a constant awareness of my Center of Gravity (COG).

I use vibration movements to send information from one hand to the other.

There's a battle between manmade massage gadgets & the human touch. Technology will forever improve, will we? Feel for more, don’t just pet.
